name: Potencial relatiu de refugi climatic

sources.temperature: USGS Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Temperature
sources.hydrology_context: ACA and project-normalized official hydrology layers

method.normalization: Each component clipped to its documented P10-P90 interval within Alinya

limitations: Relative screening layer based on a two-summer daytime LST composite and one Sentinel-2 date. It is not air temperature, a climatic normal, microclimate monitoring or a field-validated refuge inventory. Weights and thresholds are explicit EcoRadar analysis assumptions.
